title: Dying Balanced
description: When you die, your items will be fire proof, you will be able to configure despawn time, the items will glow and you will receive a compass that points towards where you died and the compass has the dimension and exact coordinates as the item name
body:
Dying Balanced re-engineers the recovery loop in Minecraft, keeping 
your items safe from hazards without removing the challenge of travel.

FEATURES:
- Death Compass: Automatically given upon respawn. Shows exact 
  death coordinates and dimension on the item name (no chat spam).
- Safe Recovery: Death loot is glowing and fireproof.
- Long-lasting Loot: Death loot stays on the ground for as long as you set it to (default setting: 11 minutes).
- Anti-Exploit: Regular drops (pressing 'Q') remain 100% vanilla and burn.


INSTALLATION GUIDE:
1. Download the "Dying_Balanced.zip" folder.
2. Put the zipped folder inside your world's datapack folder:
   -> .minecraft/saves/YOUR_WORLD/datapacks/
3. Open your world or server and type: /reload

HOW TO CHANGE CONFIGURATIONS:
You can change settings anytime! Open this file inside the pack:
-> data/dying_balanced/function/config.mcfunction

To turn settings on or off, swap the numbers between 1 (True) or 0 (False).
Type /reload in-game to apply any changes.
